findings.evidence: The descriptor reader has a second category-blind parse bound: 8192 items per descriptor, every item at every nesting level. It refuses the whole lfx2 descriptor with the same descriptor_item_limit, so a visible stack with counted instances is lost whatever its categories, like the 512 list cap. The new clause states the 512 cap only (the lane's residual list names both). The synthetic test instances charge 3 items each (list entry, Md, enab), so 1501 instances fit (layer 1 of the ceiling test); an instance with 7 or more items makes 1024 + 1 instances exceed 8192, so for such instances the aggregate cap, not Folio's 1024 ceiling (PLR-063, R21-S1) nor the 512 list cap, decides the outcome. How many items a Photoshop-authored effect instance holds is UNVERIFIED here (no outbound read); if it is around 15-25 as the parsed keys of map_effect suggest (Md, Clr object, Opct, uglg, lagl, Dstn, Ckmt, blur, Nose, AntA, TrnS object, layerConceals, enab, showInDialog), the ceiling cut and its dropped=<count> entry are reached only by stacks of small instances. Outcome is fail-closed (typed Unsupported, block byte-exact, import continues).
findings.repair_direction: Lead decision: extend the PLR-086 DOC clause to the aggregate cap ('and the 8192-item cap per descriptor'), and optionally measure a real Photoshop instance's item count before deciding whether the ceiling path needs a larger aggregate bound for lfx2 (V4-02 trade-off).

findings.evidence: Note-range bookkeeping is sound by reading: a range is recorded only for a KEPT switched-off instance that added notes, ranges are ascending and disjoint (the vector only grows except truncate(notes_from) for the current instance, whose notes_from is >= every recorded end), later notes (counted instances, unmappable instances, effect_slot_malformed, effect_single_and_multi_slots_merged) sit outside the ranges, drop_switched_off drains last to first, and a second call removes nothing (off_notes drained; after an over-stack cut uncounted == 0 so admit cannot return CountedOnly). drop_switched_off runs only when enabled && visible (counted > 0), where 'not counted' == 'not enabled', so the retain and the drained ranges describe the same instances. off_notes holds <= 1024 pairs; the scan still holds <= 64 counted + 1024 switched-off instances. The debug_assert_eq at :678 is compiled out in release; the reported count is the measured removal, so release output is exact regardless.
